name: Qing Mo Zhi Yu
source:
Love stories often come to an abrupt end after two people start dating, and the many obstacles that follow are always left unsaid. When summer ends in an unexpected rainstorm, will the two see each other's gradually disappearing figures in the misty rain or on the next sunny day, when the azure sky is reflected in the puddles on the ground?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833040/]Steam[/url]]
